_desc: R3.x lossy gate (FORCED, deterministic) — drive via tools/dm_diff_band.py --band 0 --funnel report --expect-drops 1 --min-delivery full. alice sends N msgs to bob (direct, explicit link) but the FIRST RTS (alice->bob) is force-dropped, so msg #1 fires EXACTLY one RTS retry (the retry-jitter draw) and recovers via a clean fresh handshake on BOTH engines. The channel is kept QUIET during the send window (long beacon_period suppresses steady beacons after discovery exit ~13.5s; first send at 18s clears the last discovery beacon ~17.7s; probabilistic per-frame losses disabled) so the ONLY loss is the forced drop -> both engines deliver N/N. The retry FUNNEL is REPORTED not asserted (it diverges by wire-airtime design: lua emits a retry as the distinct RTS-rty event, meshroute re-emits rts_tx); the gate asserts per-pair delivery (band 0 + min-delivery full) and that the drop fired (expect-drops). Not runnable directly (nodes carry no engine/script).
